chapter: Clarifications and portraits: Lester Young, Byas, Blanton, Ben Webster
title: The Young family: Lester, Lee and Irma, and Lee Young becoming a drummer
summary: Lee Young learned drums from Cozy Cole; the family band; Lester briefly followed Hawkins in Henderson's band.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: And skatten. WILLARD: When you first got to know Lester Young. where was he living? (Recording Interruption).
Right next door to 802 on Central Avenue, Local you know.
That was Local 767, 802 is New York.
So and his sister could play some saxophone, Irma.
Oh.
Yeah.
Were there three children in the family?
Lester, Lee and Irma. Now Irma has a daughter that can play hell out of piano right now. She's up north somewhere.
What is her name?
I don't know.
Up north, in California?
Well, San Francisco, Sacramento, somewhere around in there.
So you first got to know the Young family when you were --

Now, I met Lee as a dancer. And Lee got hooked on drums behind Cozy Cole[.]. See Stuff Smith came out here and played the Famous Door and Cozy was chewing gum, you know. And this hotel room, he didn't have a practice pad. He had one of these restaurant plates wrapped up in a bath towel and he'd use that for a practice pad. And Lee would just hang around him all the time. And by Lee being a dancer, he had the rhythm concept, you know. And he bought him a pair of drums, a drum set and within a month he was swinging everybody off of Central Avenue, you know,

And then he got in the book. And started learning his paradiddles and his ratamacues and everything flam you know, like Cozy was doing. And he got real agressive as a drummer. He took over the city as a drummer practically because when he joined King Cole. He was, his reading was such that he could conduct a band. And if anyone in the band made a mistake on reading their part, he'd jump up off the drums and go and correct them, you know. And they say "wow".

And when King Cole had an engagement to play, he went in advance to rehearse the band. He was a musician. All just brought it out of him. Now the family, they had a family band and Lester was playing piano, I think he started on the piano. But in the band, he played trumpet and drums. And Lee danced and Irma played saxophone. I think Lee played trumpet
and the father played drums and Moms played piano. I think that's how it was. If I'm wrong, I stand to be corrected. But they all, you know, it was a family band.
That was here in Los Angeles?
No, this was around Texas. They are travelled, you know.
Didn't his father originally have a band with the circus when Lester was very small?
A circus or carnival or one. I'm not sure.
But when they got to Los Angeles, that was after that, right?
Yeah.
And they didn't have a family band?
No.
Was Lester -- Lester was playing around Los Angeles?

No, no. Lester went back to Kansas City and he had an occasion to follow Coleman Hawkins in Fletcher Henderson's Band. But he didn't stay very long because he didn't have that full sound that Hawk had. And he wasn't accepted so he left the band and returned back to Kansas City. But as of today, all of the avant gardes, they're trying to get that Lester Young sound.
